008package paint.viewer.ui.dialogs;
009
010import paint.viewer.ui.panels.SquareGridPanel;
011import paint.viewer.model.SquareControlParams;
012
013import javax.swing.*;
014import javax.swing.event.ChangeEvent;
015import javax.swing.event.ChangeListener;
016import java.awt.*;
017
018import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.MAX_VARIABILITY;
019import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.MIN_DENSITY_RATIO;
020import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.NEIGHBOUR_MODE;
021
022/**
023 * A dialog for configuring square control parameters in the viewer.
024 * <p>
025 * Provides interactive sliders and radio buttons that allow users to adjust
026 * key square filtering parameters. Changes are previewed live in the main
027 * viewer; pressing an Apply button commits and saves the configuration.
028 */
029public class SquareControlDialog extends JDialog {
030
031    /**
032     * Listener interface for responding to square control parameter changes.
033     */
034    public interface SquareControlListener {
035        /**
036         * Defines the persistence scope for applied parameters.
037         */
038        enum Scope {
039            /** Temporary preview in the UI. */
040            PREVIEW("Preview"),
041            /** Persist only for the current recording. */
042            RECORDING("Recording"),
043            /** Persist for all recordings in the current experiment. */
044            EXPERIMENT("Experiment"),
045            /** Persist for all experiments in the project. */
046            PROJECT("Project");
047
048            private final String label;
049
050            Scope(String label) {
051                this.label = label;
052            }
053
054            /** @return the display label for the scope */
055            public String label() {
056                return label;
057            }
058        }
059
060        /**
061         * Called when parameters are applied (or previewed).
062         *
063         * @param scope  the target persistence scope
064         * @param params the new parameter values
065         */
066        void onApplySquareControl(Scope scope, SquareControlParams params);
067    }
068
069    private final SquareControlListener squareControlListener;
070
071    private final JSlider       densityRatioSlider;
072    private final JSlider       variabilitySlider;
073    private final JSlider       rSquaredSlider;
074    private final JLabel        densityRatioValue;
075    private final JLabel        variabilityValue;
076    private final JLabel        rSquaredValue;
077    private final JRadioButton  neighbourFree;
078    private final JRadioButton  neighbourRelaxed;
079    private final JRadioButton  neighbourStrict;
080    private final double        origDensityRatio;
081    private final double        origVariability;
082    private final double        origRSquared;
083    private final String        origNeighbourMode;
084    /**
085     * Constructs a dialog that enables interactive adjustment of square grid
086     * parameters such as Density Ratio, Variability, and R² thresholds.
087     *
088     * @param owner      the parent frame that owns this dialog
089     * @param gridPanel  the grid panel to update visually during preview
090     * @param squareControlListener   squareControlListener receiving apply and preview callbacks
091     * @param initParams the initial square control parameters
092     */
093    public SquareControlDialog(JFrame                owner,
094                               SquareGridPanel       gridPanel,
095                               SquareControlListener squareControlListener,
096                               SquareControlParams   initParams) {
097        super(owner, "Square Controls", false);
098        this.squareControlListener = squareControlListener;
099
100        setLayout(new BorderLayout(10, 10));
101
102        JPanel content = new JPanel();
103        content.setLayout(new BoxLayout(content, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
104
105        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
106        // Sliders
107        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
108
109        densityRatioSlider = createSteppedSlider(
110                0,               // min
111                2000,            // max
112                2,               // step
113                initParams.minRequiredDensityRatio
114        );
115        variabilitySlider = createSteppedSlider(
116                0,
117                20,
118                1,
119                initParams.maxAllowableVariability
120        );
121
122        rSquaredSlider = createSteppedSlider(
123                0.0,
124                1.0,
125                0.05,
126                initParams.minRequiredRSquared
127        );
128        densityRatioValue = new JLabel();
129        variabilityValue  = new JLabel();
130        rSquaredValue     = new JLabel();
131
132        JPanel slidersPanel = new JPanel(new GridLayout(1, 3, 15, 0));
133        slidersPanel.setBorder(BorderFactory.createTitledBorder("Square Filters"));
134        slidersPanel.add(wrapSlider(densityRatioSlider, MIN_DENSITY_RATIO, densityRatioValue));
135        slidersPanel.add(wrapSlider(variabilitySlider,  MAX_VARIABILITY,   variabilityValue));
136        slidersPanel.add(wrapSlider(rSquaredSlider, "Min R²", rSquaredValue));
137
138        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
139        // Neighbour mode radio buttons
140        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
141
142        neighbourFree    = new JRadioButton("Free");
143        neighbourRelaxed = new JRadioButton("Relaxed");
144        neighbourStrict  = new JRadioButton("Strict");
145
146        ButtonGroup neighbourGroup = new ButtonGroup();
147        neighbourGroup.add(neighbourFree);
148        neighbourGroup.add(neighbourRelaxed);
149        neighbourGroup.add(neighbourStrict);
150
151        switch (initParams.neighbourMode) {
152            case "Relaxed":
153                neighbourRelaxed.setSelected(true);
154                break;
155            case "Strict":
156                neighbourStrict.setSelected(true);
157                break;
158            default:
159                neighbourFree.setSelected(true);
160        }
161
162        JPanel neighbourPanel = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.LEFT));
163        neighbourPanel.setBorder(BorderFactory.createTitledBorder(NEIGHBOUR_MODE));
164        neighbourPanel.add(neighbourFree);
165        neighbourPanel.add(neighbourRelaxed);
166        neighbourPanel.add(neighbourStrict);
167        neighbourPanel.setAlignmentX(Component.CENTER_ALIGNMENT);
168
169        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
170        // Apply / Cancel controls
171        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
172
173        JPanel applyPanel       = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.LEFT));
174        applyPanel.setBorder(BorderFactory.createTitledBorder("Apply Changes"));
175        JButton applyRecording  = new JButton("Apply to Recording");
176        JButton applyExperiment = new JButton("Apply to Experiment");
177        JButton applyProject    = new JButton("Apply to Project");
178        JButton cancelButton    = new JButton("Cancel");
179
180        for (JButton b : new JButton[]{applyRecording, applyExperiment, applyProject, cancelButton}) {
181            b.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(180, 28));
182        }
183
184        applyPanel.add(applyRecording);
185        applyPanel.add(applyExperiment);
186        applyPanel.add(applyProject);
187        applyPanel.add(cancelButton);
188        applyPanel.setAlignmentX(Component.CENTER_ALIGNMENT);
189
190        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
191        // Layout assembly
192        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
193        content.add(slidersPanel);
194        content.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(10));
195        content.add(neighbourPanel);
196        content.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(10));
197        content.add(applyPanel);
198        add(content, BorderLayout.CENTER);
199
200        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
201        // Listeners for live preview
202        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
203        ChangeListener sliderListener = new ChangeListener() {
204            @Override
205            public void stateChanged(ChangeEvent e) {
206                updateValueLabels();
207                propagatePreview();
208                SwingUtilities.invokeLater(gridPanel::repaint);
209            }
210        };
211        densityRatioSlider.addChangeListener(sliderListener);
212        variabilitySlider.addChangeListener(sliderListener);
213        rSquaredSlider.addChangeListener(sliderListener);
214
215        neighbourFree.addActionListener(   e -> propagatePreview());
216        neighbourRelaxed.addActionListener(e -> propagatePreview());
217        neighbourStrict.addActionListener( e -> propagatePreview());
218
219        // Apply button actions (commit and write to the file)
220        applyRecording.addActionListener(e -> {
221            squareControlListener.onApplySquareControl(SquareControlListener.Scope.RECORDING, collectParams());
222            dispose();
223        });
224        applyExperiment.addActionListener(e -> {
225            squareControlListener.onApplySquareControl(SquareControlListener.Scope.EXPERIMENT, collectParams());
226            dispose();
227        });
228        applyProject.addActionListener(e -> {
229            squareControlListener.onApplySquareControl(SquareControlListener.Scope.PROJECT, collectParams());
230            dispose();
231        });
232
233        cancelButton.addActionListener(e -> closeAction());
234
235        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
236        // Preserve original values for cancel/restore
237        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
238
239        origDensityRatio  = initParams.minRequiredDensityRatio;
240        origVariability   = initParams.maxAllowableVariability;
241        origRSquared      = initParams.minRequiredRSquared;
242        origNeighbourMode = initParams.neighbourMode;
243
244        updateValueLabels();
245        propagatePreview();
246
247        pack();
248        setLocationRelativeTo(owner);
249
250        // Make sure that pressing the red close button is doung the same as cancel
251        setDefaultCloseOperation(WindowConstants.DO_NOTHING_ON_CLOSE);
252        addWindowListener(new java.awt.event.WindowAdapter() {
253            @Override
254            public void windowClosing(java.awt.event.WindowEvent e) {
255                closeAction();
256            }
257        });
258    }
259
260    /**
261     * Wraps a slider and value label inside a titled panel.
262     */
263    private JPanel wrapSlider(JSlider slider, String title, JLabel valueLabel) {
264        JPanel panel = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
265        panel.setBorder(BorderFactory.createTitledBorder(title));
266        panel.add(slider, BorderLayout.CENTER);
267        valueLabel.setHorizontalAlignment(SwingConstants.CENTER);
268        panel.add(valueLabel, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
269        return panel;
270    }
271
272    /**
273     * Updates the numeric labels to reflect current slider values.
274     */
275    private void updateValueLabels() {
276        densityRatioValue.setText(
277                formatSliderValue(getSliderDouble(densityRatioSlider, 0, 2), 2)
278        );
279        variabilityValue.setText(
280                formatSliderValue(getSliderDouble(variabilitySlider, 0, 1), 1)
281        );
282        rSquaredValue.setText(
283                formatSliderValue(getSliderDouble(rSquaredSlider, 0.0, 0.05), 0.05)
284        );
285    }
286
287    /**
288     * Sends live parameter updates for real-time preview without persistence.
289     */
290    private void propagatePreview() {
291        squareControlListener.onApplySquareControl(SquareControlListener.Scope.PREVIEW, collectParams());
292    }
293
294    /**
295     * Returns the currently selected neighbour mode string.
296     */
297    private String getNeighbourMode() {
298        if (neighbourFree.isSelected()) {
299            return "Free";
300        }
301        if (neighbourRelaxed.isSelected()) {
302            return "Relaxed";
303        }
304        return "Strict";
305    }
306
307    /**
308     * Restores original slider and neighbour mode values, updating the preview.
309     */
310    private void restoreOriginals() {
311        densityRatioSlider.setValue((int) Math.round(origDensityRatio / 2.0));
312        variabilitySlider.setValue((int) Math.round(origVariability / 1.0));
313        rSquaredSlider.setValue((int) Math.round(origRSquared / 0.05));
314
315        switch (origNeighbourMode) {
316            case "Relaxed":
317                neighbourRelaxed.setSelected(true);
318                break;
319            case "Strict":
320                neighbourStrict.setSelected(true);
321                break;
322            default:
323                neighbourFree.setSelected(true);
324        }
325
326        updateValueLabels();
327        propagatePreview();
328    }
329
330    /**
331     * Collects the current slider and neighbour mode state into a parameter object.
332     */
333    private SquareControlParams collectParams() {
334        return new SquareControlParams(
335                getSliderDouble(densityRatioSlider, 0, 2),
336                getSliderDouble(variabilitySlider, 0, 1),
337                getSliderDouble(rSquaredSlider, 0.0, 0.05),
338                getNeighbourMode()
339        );
340    }
341
342    private JSlider createSteppedSlider(double min, double max, double step, double initialValue) {
343
344        int steps = (int) Math.round((max - min) / step);
345        int initial = (int) Math.round((initialValue - min) / step);
346
347        JSlider slider = new JSlider(JSlider.VERTICAL, 0, steps,
348                                     Math.max(0, Math.min(steps, initial)));
349
350        // We want major ticks ONLY
351        slider.setPaintTicks(true);
352        slider.setSnapToTicks(false);  // IMPORTANT: manual snapping below
353        slider.setMinorTickSpacing(0); // no minor ticks
354
355        // Major tick spacing (labelled)
356        int major = Math.max(1, steps / 5);
357        slider.setMajorTickSpacing(major);
358
359        // Label table for major ticks only
360        java.util.Hashtable<Integer, JLabel> table = new java.util.Hashtable<>();
361        for (int i = 0; i <= steps; i += major) {
362            double v = min + (i * step);
363            table.put(i, new JLabel(formatSliderValue(v, step)));
364        }
365        slider.setLabelTable(table);
366        slider.setPaintLabels(true);
367
368        return slider;
369    }
370
371    private String formatSliderValue(double v, double step) {
372
373        // Integer step → format as integer
374        if (step >= 1.0) {
375            return Integer.toString((int) Math.round(v));
376        }
377
378        // Step of 0.1 → one decimal
379        if (Math.abs(step - 0.1) < 1e-9) {
380            return String.format("%.1f", v);
381        }
382
383        // Step of 0.05 → two decimals
384        if (Math.abs(step - 0.05) < 1e-9) {
385            return String.format("%.2f", v);
386        }
387
388        // Default fallback
389        return String.valueOf(v);
390    }
391
392    private double getSliderDouble(JSlider slider, double min, double step) {
393        return min + slider.getValue() * step;
394    }
395
396    private void closeAction() {
397        restoreOriginals();
398        dispose();
399    }
400}
